claim: In 1930, Albert Einstein and Elsa Einstein arrived in San Diego on the Belgenland.

evidence.quote: Albert Einstein arrives in San Diego, California
Albert Einstein debarks the S.S. Belgenland in San Diego, California. Einstein and his wife, Elsa (second from left), are greeted
Albert Einstein and Elsa Einstein arriving by ship, San Diego, 1930
View of Albert Einstein and Elsa Einstein aboard the ship, the SS Belgenland, upon their arrival in San Diego.
